datasets.description: Apple Inc. / Tim Cook sample. The canonical KGVisualizer demonstration input.
datasets.include_reason: Canonical demonstration input for KGVisualizer + SemanticNetworkVisualizer + OntologyVisualizer + EmbeddingVisualizer. Two typed entities (Organization/Person), one structural typed relationship (CEO_of), three labelled embedding items, and a small derived ontology. Literal values are transcribed from Semantica's documented default example and recorded verbatim in the generator; the embedding payload is a deterministic synthetic projection explicitly labelled synthetic.
